name: Barrage

categories.label: Victory points on the track
categories.help: Victory points on the board track before final scoring (contracts, bonus tiles, technology and everything scored during the five rounds).

categories.label: Objective tile
categories.help: Points from the Objective tile: 15 for first, 10 for second, 5 for third; tied players split their tiers evenly, rounding up.

categories.label: Sets of five resources
categories.help: Excavators, Concrete Mixers and Credits in your personal supply, counted together (not those still on the Construction Wheel); enter the number of full sets of 5.

categories.label: Water Drops in dams
categories.help: One point for each Water Drop held in your Personal Dams.

categories.label: Energy in the last round
categories.help: Energy Units you produced in the fifth round; the most wins a tie.

notes: Base game only. Read from a Tabletopia-hosted copy of the publisher rulebook PDF (Cranio Creations), not from the publisher site; the rulebook refers to 2-4 player setups, so 2-4 is taken from its setup text. Solo/Automa rules, the 5th-player expansion and the Duel version are excluded. The track entry covers all in-game scoring and includes any laps past 100.
